entities.summary: Kryspin Witold Dubiel is a Polish prelate of the Catholic Church who works in the diplomatic service of the Holy See. He is currently the Apostolic Nuncio to Angola and São Tomé and Príncipe, and also the Titular Archbishop of Vannida.
